description: To develop the ability to research a technical topic independently and present it clearly, and to build skills in structured group discussion and technical communication.

syllabus.title: Seminar and Group Discussion
syllabus.body: Each student identifies a recent topic/technology in Computer Science and Engineering, prepares a technical report and delivers a seminar presentation, followed by a moderated group discussion and peer evaluation on contemporary topics in the discipline.

outcomes: Independently research and present a technical topic.
Participate effectively in structured technical group discussions.
Improve written and oral technical communication skills.
